endpoints.truth_yaml:
post:
  operationId: postWorkspacesInvoicesItems
  summary: Add a line item to an invoice
  x-verification-status: LIVE-VERIFIED
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-020000-post.workspaces.invoices.items-dry-run.json
  x-notes: |
    LIVE-VERIFIED via dry_run probe. dry_run ok:true confirms path and payload shape.
    Upstream payload fields: applyTaxes, itemType, unitPrice, quantity, description.
    unit_price sent in minor units (cents) by default; MCP multiplies by 100 for major.
    Both specs agree on this path. No discrepancies.
  x-truth-iter: iter18
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
    - name: invoiceId
      in: path
      required: true
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          required:
            - itemType
          properties:
            itemType:
              type: string
            description:
              type: string
            quantity:
              type: number
            unitPrice:
              type: number
              description: In minor units (cents)
            applyTaxes:
              type: string
              enum: [TAX1, TAX2, TAX1TAX2, NONE]
endpoints.notes: dry_run ok:true confirms path is live. Payload uses itemType (not item_type), unitPrice (not unit_price), applyTaxes. Both specs agree. No discrepancies found.

discrepancies.fact: Both clockify_invoices_import_time and clockify_invoices_import_expenses POST to the same path /items/import; the importExpenses boolean in the request body selects the variant
discrepancies.live_says: Single path /workspaces/{wId}/invoices/{invoiceId}/items/import serves both time and expense imports via importExpenses flag in body
discrepancies.official_says: Both specs list this as a single path (post.workspaces.invoices.items.import)
discrepancies.ours_says: Two separate MCP tools (clockify_invoices_import_time, clockify_invoices_import_expenses) both route to the same upstream path — correct

discrepancies.fact: Response shape is full invoice object, not just imported items
discrepancies.live_says: Returns full invoice JSON including items[], status, amount, taxes, etc.
discrepancies.ours_says: invoiceItemViewFromRaw processes the response — the MCP view normalizes the shape

endpoints.truth_yaml:
post:
  operationId: postWorkspacesInvoicesItemsImport
  summary: Import billable time or expenses onto an invoice by date range
  x-verification-status: LIVE-VERIFIED
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-020000-post.workspaces.invoices.items.import-happy-path.json
  x-notes: |
    LIVE-VERIFIED. Happy-path probe returned ok:true (HTTP 200).
    Both clockify_invoices_import_time and clockify_invoices_import_expenses POST
    to this single path; importExpenses boolean in body selects the variant.
    Response is the full invoice object, not just imported items.
    date-only 'to' is coerced to end-of-day (23:59:59Z) by the MCP layer.
    Both specs agree on path. No spec discrepancies.
  x-truth-iter: iter18
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
    - name: invoiceId
      in: path
      required: true
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          required:
            - from
            - to
          properties:
            from:
              type: string
              format: date-time
              description: Start of billing window (RFC3339)
            to:
              type: string
              format: date-time
              description: End of billing window (RFC3339)
            importExpenses:
              type: boolean
              default: false
            timeEntryGroupType:
              type: string
              enum: [SINGLE_ITEM, GROUPED, DETAILED]
            timeEntryPrimaryGroupBy:
              type: string
              enum: [USER, PROJECT, DATE]
            projectFilter:
              type: object
endpoints.notes: Live HTTP 200 confirmed. Single path for both import_time and import_expenses tools (importExpenses flag differentiates). Response returns full invoice object. Both specs agree on path.
